verdict.rationale: Kick supports event-triggered automation (Rules that 'run automatically every time a matching transaction syncs') and MCP/CLI access that lets AI 'automate month-end checks' and build workflows across workspaces, but there is no documented time-based scheduler, cron-like recurrence, or scheduled report/job execution — automation is reactive to transaction events, not scheduled on a cadence. Missing for 10: explicit recurring/time-scheduled job configuration, evidence of scheduled report delivery or periodic automated runs, and independent confirmation that MCP/CLI workflows can be set to run on a schedule rather than only on-demand or on-sync.
